channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Why is Iran exempting India, China, Qatar, Iraq from Hormuz restrictions?
item.description: Tehran says ships from four countries can cross Hormuz freely, but analysts say the deals carry political risks.

item.title: Iraq’s al-Zaidi talks to Trump as Baghdad seeks to stay out of war on Iran
item.description: Call comes as Iraq's top diplomat urges armed groups not to join any Iranian retaliation to US attacks.

item.title: Iran’s security chief meets Putin, delivers message from Khamenei
item.description: Putin meets Iran's top security official to discuss regional security and receives a letter from Mojtaba Khamenei.

item.title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
item.description: One child and one young adult were killed in the crash, local authorities say, with more injured.

item.title: Major construction ongoing near Iran missile bases, satellite images suggest
item.description: Evidence of digging and new buildings are visible in satellite imagery taken in November, satellite images suggest.

item.title: Eight killed in series of shootings in western Turkey
item.description: Victims are found in several locations in three separate vehicles, according to local reports.

item.title: A wildfire killed their loved ones in Spain. These British families demand to know why
item.description: Nine British nationals were among the 15 people who died when fire ripped through the village of Bédar this summer.

item.title: Vance walks Trump tightrope with scathing election critique blaming Iran war
item.description: The vice-president's blunt assessment of Republican election defeat marked one of the sharpest breaks with a sitting president in recent memory.

item.title: Who could be behind hoax bomb threats to European air travel?
item.description: There is no hard evidence so far linking airline bomb threats to Russia, Iran or any proxy groups.
